newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares close higher despite fall abroad.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares close higher despite fall abroad.

text.p: 1710 GMT - Portuguese shares ended higher unlike other European markets in heavy turnover of 13 billion escudos, with activity centred on Champalimaud group bank Banco Totta & Acores.

* Banco Totta & Acores, whose stock crashed this week on worse than expected profits, rallied strongly but analysts said that the upside from here was limited. Totta closed at 2,650 escudos, up 200, in volume of 275,672 shares.

* Dealers were reluctant to forecast the trend on the Lisbon bourse on Monday as it bucked the trend of other markets which fell on Friday, rattled by a negative opening on Wall Street which added to fears that the rally in world markets might have run its course.
"I've no idea what will happen on Monday. Other bourses fell and we rose. We must have been the only one to do so," said one operator.
